sentences.text: At 04:20, a cold spot began to manifest within the living room, sending a spectral signal through the sensors.
The house recorded a temperature of 16.9 °C, which was significantly below the predicted 18.0 °C.
This peculiar drop in temperature reached its peak around 05:20, causing the sensors to register a distinct chilling presence.
The strange cold lingered in the living room, maintaining its hold until 06:00.
